title: BNP Paribas action: The trend remains down under 55.20 € - Flash IG analysis 15.06.2018
description: During its sound at its general meeting which was held at the end of May, BNP Paribas excluded any major merger-acquisition operation, after a shareholder asked the general management if the French bank examined the situation of Deutsche Bank for a possible redemption. Of the graphic point of view, the title retains a downward structure since the beginning of the year, as illustrated by the succession of hollows and mobile at 100 days. Despite the net rebound of actions Thursday following the decision of monetary policy of the European Central Bank and the words of its president, the value has failed to cross its major resistance. These different elements argue for the emergence of a new wave of depreciation towards the next support, dating from 2017 and located at 52.10EUR. Only the overflow of the 55.20EUR would question this reading.    - Subscribe to our channel: https://www.youtube.com/igfrance?sub_Confirmation=1  - More info on: https://www.ig.com/fr    Twitter: https://twitter.com/igfrance  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/igfrance  Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ig-france

asr.full_text: Welcome to Flash Analysis with IG. It is Friday 15 June 2018, it is 2:30 pm. Here is the analysis of the BNP Paribas stock. At its last general meeting, held at the end of May, BNP Paribas excluded any major future acquisition operations. After a shareholder asked the general management if the French bank was examining Deutsche Bank's situation in view of a possible takeover. From a graphic perspective, the stock has maintained a bearish structure since the beginning of the year, as illustrated by the succession of downward rises and the orientation of the 100-day moving average. Despite the net share bounce on Thursday following the monetary policy decision of the ECB and its chairman, its value has not been significantly resistant to the crisis. These various elements argue for the emergence of a new wave of depreciation in the direction of the next medium dating from 2017 and located at 50.10 euros. Only the overflow of 55.20 euros would call into question this reading.
